Preserve EU, EEA EFTA, Swiss bilateral, returning-Dutch, domestic Dutch-family, third-country-sponsor and UK Withdrawal Agreement routes separately. No legal equivalence is asserted.

previous_findings_carried_forward: Use prior country packs, source taxonomy and acquisition notes as discovery leads only; verify each Dutch candidate with its responsible first-party publisher.

Carry forward the sustainability rule: stable-looking identifiers, documented APIs, open-data laws or XML availability do not by themselves prove live access, reuse rights, version completeness or deterministic conversion.
The N-Lex Netherlands connector is a national-law discovery route only. It does not establish coverage of guidance, forms, courts, oversight or regional/municipal practice.
Compare legislation, administrative guidance, forms, visa and mission practice, remedies, public access, privacy, oversight, legal aid and case law separately.
Keep Swiss and EEA EFTA routes distinct from EU-law coverage, and check domestic Dutch sponsor rules separately from mobile-Dutch EU-law cases.
